GUIDE: Dev Tools --> Sources Tab

Open the dev tools tab with CTRL + SHIFT + J or with the CTRL + SHIFT + I keyboard shortcut in Firefox. Navigate to the sources tab. Here, try making the screen large.

Multiple panels are able to collapse, and the console can be closed and opened, too. Below, the panel is used to debug the widget.
